name: prompt-770
image_purpose: social-media lifestyle composition with controlled sticker overlays

prompt.project_info: Create a cozy indoor UGC portrait of an approved adult woman seated in a modern chair, mixing photorealism with illustrated sticker overlays.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with medium-brown hair, wearing a dark oversized hoodie and blue jeans, holding a compact professional camera with one hand and resting her cheek on the other while smiling softly.
prompt.composition_elements: Seated three-quarter portrait in a warm beige minimal interior with potted plants and shelves. Add a smiling sunflower, a small hand-drawn yellow sun, and white sketch lines around the camera. Include a handwritten romantic quote only as optional user-supplied typography; do not add a creator signature or watermark.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft warm diffused studio light, cozy romantic mood, gentle shadows, cinematic depth of field.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic natural skin texture with clean illustrated overlays, portrait orientation, 3:4 ratio, 50mm lens, moderate depth of field, high detail.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Approved adult woman with medium-brown hair sits casually in a chair in a warm beige minimal interior, wearing a dark oversized hoodie and blue jeans, holding a compact camera and resting her cheek on one hand with a soft dreamy smile. Add controlled sunflower and sun doodles plus white camera sketch lines. Preserve supplied typography only when attached; no creator signature, watermark, or invented logo.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, sexualized pose, nudity, lingerie, transparent clothing, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed camera, cluttered background, unreadable text, creator signature, watermark, logo invention, public figure likeness.

assets.name: prompt-770_0.jpg
assets.usage: Subject, outfit, chair, camera, interior, lighting, doodle placement, and typography layout reference.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required local image. Preserve identity, outfit, camera, chair, environment, lighting, and sticker placement; replaceability applies only to an intentionally supplied approved identity reference. Treat the quote as optional attachable typography and keep it replaceable; never reproduce the visible creator signature unless explicitly supplied and approved.

changes: Removed creator-name/signature reproduction and made the quote optional replaceable typography.
